factual_claims.source_evidence: The Liability Management section states: 'As part of a series of liability management exercises in January 2025, Heimstaden issued SEK 750 million senior unsecured floating rate notes and EUR 430 million senior unsecured fixed rate notes... Heimstaden further supplemented its liability management programme in a July 2025 exercise that refinanced Heimstaden's previous March 2027 EUR 400 million senior unsecured fixed rate note through the issuance of a EUR 400 million senior note due January 2031.' The total EUR issuance is EUR 830 million.

factual_claims.claim: Additionally, an arbitral tribunal ruled favorably in December 2025 regarding an arbitration case initiated by Alecta, confirming no breach of the Shareholders Agreement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Q4 Highlights section states: 'In December 2025, an award in favour of Heimstaden was received in the arbitration case initiated by Alecta against Heimstaden confirming that there was no breach in the Shareholders Agreement of Heimstaden Bostad.'

factual_claims.claim: Overall, Heimstaden advanced its strategic focus on cost discipline, deleveraging, and portfolio efficiency, resulting in improved profitability margins and strengthened financial stability during 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The report consistently emphasizes cost control, digitalisation, privatisation proceeds reducing debt, improved margins, and strengthened credit metrics. The Management Discussion highlights these strategic priorities and their positive outcomes.
